subject.title: feat: show Codex transcripts in the sidebar

question: Should OpenClaw ship this experimental cross-host Codex transcript surface now, after capability gating and real mixed-version proof, or defer it until the upstream method and fleet upgrade path are more stable?
rationale: The feature adds a user-visible supervision contract and a new paired-node command backed by an experimental dependency API, so maintainers must accept the stability and upgrade burden.

options.title: Gate, prove, and land
options.body: Keep the feature, add explicit per-host read capability gating, and require real local and paired-node upgrade proof before merge.

options.title: Defer the feature
options.body: Keep the catalog-only supervision surface until the Codex pagination API and node upgrade contract are stable.

recommendation.title: Gate, prove, and land
recommendation.body: Keep the feature, add explicit per-host read capability gating, and require real local and paired-node upgrade proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The current Codex supervision implementation and recent sidebar work trace primarily to this person.
